title: Store Manager
description:
1.Store Operations Management: Oversee daily operations of Insta360's North America direct-operated store, develop and execute sales strategies to achieve revenue and profit targets, ensuring compliance with brand standards and North American retail regulations.
2.Sales & Customer Service: Lead sales of high-end products such as action cameras/panoramic cameras, provide professional product demonstrations and technical consultations, handle customer complaints, and enhance customer satisfaction and repurchase rate.
3.Team Management: Recruit, train, schedule, and conduct performance management for local teams; build a cohesive sales team and improve employees' product knowledge and sales capabilities.
4.Inventory & Financial Management: Monitor inventory levels, optimize replenishment processes to reduce losses; manage store budgets, control costs, and be responsible for P&L and financial statement analysis.
5.Brand Promotion & Marketing: Plan and execute localized promotional activities, collaborate with communities and KOLs to enhance brand influence, and collect market feedback to optimize operational strategies.
6.Compliance & Safety: Ensure store operations comply with local North American laws and regulations (labor, tax, privacy), and implement safety measures to protect personnel and assets.

1.Education & Language: Bachelor’s degree or above; Fluent in English (speaking, listening, reading, writing); Second language proficiency is a plus.
2.Work Experience: 3+ years of retail management experience, with 1-2 years in consumer electronics/camera/sports gear industry; North American local retail experience is preferred; Familiar with POS systems and inventory management software.
3.Product & Technology: Basic understanding of action camera/panoramic imaging technology; Ability to quickly master core advantages of Insta360 products (AI features, anti-shake technology, image processing, etc.).
4.Core Competencies: Excellent leadership and team management skills; Sharp market insight and data analysis capabilities; Strong communication, negotiation, and customer service awareness; High pressure resistance and adaptability to fast-paced work environments.
5.Compliance & Culture: Familiar with North American business culture and consumer habits, understanding of local retail regulations; Experience in cross-cultural team management is a plus.
6.Others: Valid work authorization in North America; Willing to work flexible hours (including weekends/holidays).

title: 香港售后账务专员
description:
1、售后备件物料调拨管理：售后备件物料的调拨申请，审核调拨单据合理性，确保调拨流程合规；监控调拨过程中的库存差异，跟进差异处理，并完成账务调整。
2、仓库账务管理：负责仓库的物料消耗数据核对，确保领用、消耗、退库数据与系统匹配；定期核查仓库库存台账，识别异常消耗，推动整改并跟踪闭环；
3、库存盘点与差异分析：组织仓库的定期盘点，制定盘点计划、监督执行；收集汇总盘点表，核对账实差异，编制《盘点差异分析报告》，追溯差异根因；
4、流程优化与系统支持：梳理服务点退货流程（如B端亚马逊等退货入库，不良品返厂、呆滞料退库），协助完成退货单下推，针对高频问题（如重复领料、账实不符）制定SOP操作手册；

1、base香港，需要港籍具备在当地合法工作资质
2、本科及以上学历，会计学、财务管理等相关专业优先；
3、2年以上工作经验，有3C消费类电子产品账务工作经历优先；
4、熟悉WMS, OMS，SAP系统及Office办公软件和函数运用；
5、熟悉电子行业常见账务要求（如序列号管理、最小包装单位换算）;
6、细致严谨，对数字敏感，能发现单据或系统中的微小差异;
7、积极主动，责任心强，具备良好的理解沟通能力及团队合作精神，能承受较大的工作压力。
